parse_expr: parse a criteria expression string like os=windows into an evaluable ExprNode with valid variables
eval_ExprNode: evaluate an ExprNode against a context dictionary to return a boolean result
create_EqualExpr: create an EqualExpr node that checks if a context key equals a specified value
create_NotExpr: create a NotExpr node that negates the boolean result of another ExprNode
create_AllExpr: create an AllExpr node that returns True only if all child ExprNodes evaluate to True
